title: What Is a Skill Worth? Structure-Aware Shapley Valuation of Agent Skills
title_zh: 一个技能值多少钱？面向 Agent 技能的结构感知 Shapley 估值
abstract_en: Agent skills are increasingly optimized by automated feedback loops, producing long structured artifacts whose internal value remains unclear. We study skill valuation: assigning credit to the internal units of a fixed skill, such as rules, examples, scripts, and heuristics, under a fixed agent and held-out task distribution. Skill valuation differs from data or prompt-span valuation because skill units are structured: they may depend on other units, belong to a document hierarchy, trigger agent behavior, and consume limited prompt context. We introduce SkillSV, a structure-aware Shapley-style framework for skill valuation. SkillSV compiles a skill into units, dependencies, and hierarchy, so that only valid counterfactual skills are evaluated. It uses paired deletion and length-neutral padding to separate content value from context cost, and estimates the resulting values with a rollout-budgeted estimator for noisy agent evaluations. On four agentic benchmarks, we assess the faithfulness, actionability, and explanation of SkillSV: it recovers unit interactions, preserves aggregate skill lift, and guides safe pruning and compression.
abstract_zh: 随着 Agent 技能越来越多地通过自动反馈循环进行优化，其产出的长篇结构化技能文档内部各部分价值仍不清晰。本文研究 skill valuation：在固定 Agent 和保留任务分布下，为固定技能中的内部单元分配贡献度，例如规则、示例、脚本和启发式。与数据估值或 prompt 片段估值不同，技能单元具有结构性：它们可能依赖其他单元、属于文档层级、触发 Agent 行为，并占用有限 prompt 上下文。作者提出 SkillSV，一种结构感知的 Shapley 风格技能估值框架。SkillSV 将技能编译为单元、依赖关系和层级结构，只评估有效的反事实技能；同时使用成对删除与长度中性填充来区分内容价值和上下文成本，并在有噪声的 Agent 评测中通过受 rollout 预算约束的估计器计算价值。在四个 agentic benchmarks 上，实验从忠实性、可操作性和解释性评估 SkillSV，表明其能够恢复单元交互、保持整体技能增益，并指导安全剪枝与压缩。
key_points_zh: 提出 skill valuation 问题：为固定 Agent 技能中的规则、示例、脚本、启发式等内部单元分配贡献度。
SkillSV 将技能表示为带依赖与层级的结构，只构造并评估结构有效的反事实技能，避免无效删除导致的偏差。
通过 paired deletion 与 length-neutral padding，将技能内容本身的价值与占用 prompt 上下文带来的成本区分开。
设计 rollout-budgeted estimator，以适应 Agent 评测噪声和有限评测预算下的 Shapley 风格估计。
在四个 agentic benchmarks 上验证，SkillSV 能揭示单元交互、保持整体 skill lift，并支持安全剪枝和压缩。

llm_assessment.comment: A valuable agent-evolution method for assigning credit to structured skills and guiding pruning, compression, and improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项有价值的智能体演化方法，可为结构化技能分配信用并指导剪枝、压缩和改进。
